coverage.summary: Applies statewide to residential tenants in residential dwelling units. The text states no unit-count, construction-date, landlord-size or owner-occupancy exemptions.

result.notes: Rewrote other_conditions to describe only covered units (residential dwelling units/tenancies). The original wording 'nonpayment-of-rent notices only' described landlord conduct, not coverage. Set requires_unknown_facts to false because the rule reaches all ordinary residential tenancies without any building class that assessor data cannot identify. The statute text lists no unit-count, age or owner exemptions, so those fields stay null and unverifiable_exemptions is empty.
